about: The stops an unattended run must keep: the 18 of docs/plans/one-go/evidence/v-auto-advance.md section 2 and the calls only the person may cause (the mod's rule personOnly). check names the case or scenario that walks the stop; WP07 fills it. A stop leaves this list only with a decision record.

stops.trigger: Design changed the plan's tasks: the changed tasks need the approval
stops.check: D33a every stop of scripts/stops.json, built in an unattended run, is a question or a recorded stop

stops.trigger: open areas of concern: a true decision
stops.check: D33a every stop of scripts/stops.json, built in an unattended run, is a question or a recorded stop

stops.trigger: a failed check in a plan that declares a sensitive path (autonomy.park-on-touch): no repair by rule

stops.trigger: the row `intent unchanged since the approval` failed: a rule never changes the intent or the approved plan, so the person approves again or restores the file
stops.check: bound: an unattended run stops at the failed row: next is the park call, never a loop back
